title: Scope of part.
bodyText: This part shall not apply to the birth of a child conceived by sexual intercourse or assisted reproduction under a surrogacy agreement under part IX.
bodyHtml:
PART VIII.  ASSISTED REPRODUCTION

 

     [§584A-801]  Scope of part.  This part shall not apply to the birth of a child conceived by sexual intercourse or assisted reproduction under a surrogacy agreement under part IX. [L 2025, c 298, pt of §2]
